messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Runtime slate + roster authorization request

Team —

As discussed in last week's staffing sync, I'm formally requesting authorization to open three inbound requisitions for Q1 to shore up runtime and platform capacity:

1) Senior Runtime Engineer (IC4/IC5) — focus: model serving kernel optimizations, quantization paths, and latency regressions.
2) Platform SRE (IC4) — focus: GPU fleet reliability, autoscaling policies, and incident runbooks.
3) Compiler / Inference Engineer (IC3-IC4) — focus: operator fusion and upstream kernel work.

Rationale: recent customer growth on Redwood Dedicated + new private deployments increased tail-latency incidents; we need dedicated long-cycle work on kernel stability and a Platform SRE to reduce noisy alerts (~30% of PG tickets last quarter). Without hires we expect slower rollout of batching improvements and higher on-call load through H1.

Estimated fully-burdened headcount cost (run-rate): $740k/year for all three (see attached workbook for line-by-line). Hiring timeline: post-approval we can have reqs live in 1 week; target first offer by end of Jan.

Ask: please confirm authorization to create the three reqs and to extend provisional offers up to the bands specified in the attached spreadsheet. If there are budget constraints, indicate which role you'd prefer deprioritized.

Attachments: 2026_Q1_runtime_hc_costs.xlsx

Thanks,
Camila Reyes
Head of Runtime Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Runtime slate + roster authorization request

Camila —

Thanks for the clear note. Quick questions before I sign off:

- Can you enumerate proposed compensation bands and level for each role (IC3/4/5) and the target market (SF/remote blended)?
- Are any of these backfills vs. net-new? I recall one slot was net-new for compiler work, the other two were intended backfills but I want to be precise for finance.
- Any candidates in the pipeline (referrals/recruiter conversations)?

If the total comes in above $800k fully-burdened I may ask we prioritize two hires (SRE + Senior Runtime) and delay the compiler hire to Q2.

-Karthik
VP, Platform

Attached is the band packet and the cost workbook you asked for. TL;DR:

- Senior Runtime Engineer: target level IC4 (stretch IC5 for strong comp). Offer band (base): $210k–$240k; total comp band w/ equity & bonus: $280k–$330k.
- Platform SRE: IC4; base $170k–$195k; total comp $220k–$260k.
- Compiler / Inference Engineer: IC3 (hiring range IC3–IC4); base $150k–$175k; total comp $190k–$220k.

Fully-burdened math (includes benefits, equipment, recruiting fees):
Senior Runtime: ~$260k/year
Platform SRE: ~$205k/year
Compiler: ~$130k/year
Total: ~$595k/year (first-year ramped cost ~710k due to onboarding and signing fees). See 2026_Q1_runtime_hc_costs.xlsx for assumptions (recruiter fee at 12%, relocation allowance scenarios, equity refresh estimate).

Pipeline: recruiting has two strong inbound referrals for the Platform SRE and one passive for Senior Runtime (referred by Ben). No confirmed candidates for Compiler yet. CC'ing Ben on the referral thread.

I recommend we proceed with all three but set a hiring cadence: prioritize SRE and Senior Runtime first, post the Compiler role as medium priority and reassess after two offers.

Attachments: 2026_Q1_runtime_hc_costs.xlsx, senior_runtime_offer_band.pdf

Camila
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Thanks — reviewed the workbook and bands. Approved provisionally.

Conditions:
- Final sign-off from Finance (I will loop in Finance Ops early tomorrow; they need the workbook and the hire classification).
- Recruiting should proceed with opening the three reqs and prioritize SRE + Senior Runtime; Alyssa (cc'd) please coordinate job postings and initial candidate outreach to the SF + Remote West markets.
- Camila: if we exceed the top-of-band for any offer, escalate to me with a recommended counteroffer rationale and comp benchmark.

Ben: please share the referral intro for the Senior Runtime candidate and add to the Greenhouse notes.

If Finance signs off tomorrow, consider this greenlight to extend offers up to the bands attached.

Laura Bennett
VP, People Operations
Redwood Inference
